programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Devta

programme.title: Krantiveer

programme.title: Pataakha

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgement...

programme.title: Wafadaar

programme.title: Khwaja Mere Khwaja

programme.title: A Bug's Life

Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: A girl meets a mysterious talking rabbit and follows the creature down a hole in the ground. She finds herself in a magical world inhabited by all manner of bizarre creatures and dominated by a short-tempered queen fond of beheading those who displease her. Disney animated fantasy based on Lewis Carroll's novel, with the voices of Kathryn Beaumont and Ed Wynn.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Overworked estate agent Jim Evers takes his beleaguered family to look round an isolated, crumbling mansion - but the resident ghosts are not especially pleased to see the visitors. Comedy based on the Disney theme-park ride, starring Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly and Marsha Thomason.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: An eccentric marine expert sets out in search of a legendary shark that ate his old friend and shipmate. Unfortunately the voyage is riddled with problems, including a man claiming to be his long-lost son, a pursuing pirate crew and a rival oceanographer. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum.

programme.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
programme.desc: An old man tells a journalist the story of his youth as a lobby boy at a hotel in Eastern Europe in the 1930s. He was taken under the wing of the establishment's dashing concierge, and is drawn into his misadventures as he becomes involved in a conflict over a valuable painting. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Tony Revolori, F Murray Abraham and Jude Law.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: The Avengers
programme.desc: A mystical artefact is stolen from a top-secret military base by Thor's brother Loki, who plans to use it to bring about an alien invasion. Spymaster Nick Fury brings together a team of superheroes, including Iron Man, Thor, Captain America and the Hulk, to defend Earth from the impending attack. Action adventure uniting the Marvel comic-book characters, starring Robert Downey Jr, Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Hiddleston, Jeremy Renner and Samuel L Jackson.

Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.desc: A secret corner of Kruger National Park, where a single ribbon of water cuts through the parched land, creating a lifeline for creatures great and small

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Patrick Aryee concludes his two-part exploration of the feline family tree, revealing how the Canadian lynx learned to thrive in the snow and spread out, evolving and inhabiting new parts of the Americas. In Belize, he mounts an experiment that showcases the margay's supersharp senses and gravity-defying acrobatics, and heads to the training track with a cheetah to find out what speed it is capable of. Finally, Patrick tells the story of the cat's domestication in Essaouira, Morocco, believed to be one of the first places where one particular species first gave up life in the wild in return for food, warmth, security and a home

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: Yala National Park is home to 215 species of birds, which must either raise their offspring there or find a new home before the monsoon storms begin

programme.title: Uptown Otters
programme.desc: Mia and her newborn pups go swimming, before welcoming in an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park's main attraction

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Kenyan capture teams head to the Somalian border to find 50 rare antelopes and bring them to a safe enclosure, where their numbers can recover

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa
programme.desc: One of Earth's six great waterfalls, the mighty Augrabies provides a lifeline for any animals that live near its thunderous roar

programme.title: Monkey Life
programme.desc: In Vietnam, black-shanked douc Peter is fitted with a GPS collar before being released into the wild with his group. While in Dorset gibbons Kim and Tien are on the move to a temporary home and there's juicy melons for the spider monkeys

programme.title: Monkey Life
programme.desc: Disabled chimp Chocolate has a new friend and everyone's surprised by just who wants to be her pal. Orangutan babies Kiwi and Sibu try out their restyled playroom and a wooden puzzle for the woollies provides a great work out.

programme.title: Arctic from Above
programme.desc: Liz Bonnin travels to one of Earth's last great wildernesses to reveal fresh insights about its wildlife, including polar bears, narwhals, wolves, reindeer, leopard seals and killer whales

programme.title: The Claim
programme.desc: 2000. Romance. Director: Michael Winterbottom. Stars Peter Mullan, Milla Jovovich And Wes Bentley. A man who sold his wife and daughter to get ahead in business has his past come back to haunt him. [S]

programme.title: The Scarlet Web
programme.desc: 1954. Crime drama directed by Charles Saunders. An insurance investigator is framed for murder after a client is found dead. Starring Griffith Jones and Hazel Court. [S]

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: Bless You, G. Carter Huntington. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Ladies of Sherwood. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf And Alan Wheatley. Is it the end for Arthur of Tetsbury having raised a shire levy can Robin him save him from an untimely demise. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Ghost Ship. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Colin Douglas And Alfred Burke. Tempest encounters an abandoned Dutch Ship; he sees a prize, but the crew fear it is a ghost ship with restless spirits. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: Manhunt. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard And Jennifer Jayne. Trapped on an island owned by Prince Erik, a man who enjoys hunting prey, Tell's careers appears to be at the end. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Gabriel's Choice. 1954. Stars Clifford Evans, Lee Patterson And Mary Ward. A kindly doctor saves a man and takes him into his home - only to find himself involved in a web of treachery and intrigue. [S]

programme.title: Love from a Stranger
programme.desc: 1937. Drama. Stars Ann Harding, Basil Rathbone And Binnie Hale. A lottery winner breaks up with her fiancé and marries a fortune hunter who proves to be dangerous. [S]

programme.title: A Cry From The Streets
programme.desc: 1958. Drama starring Max Bygraves, Barbara Murray and Colin Petersen. A welfare worker becomes emotionally involved with a group of homeless children. Music by Larry Adler. [S]

programme.title: The Narrowing Circle
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Directed by Charles Saunders and starring Paul Carpenter and Hazel Court. A magazine crime writer is passed over for promotion by a rival who also steals the girl, but is murdered. [S]

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: No Identity
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by Robert Florey. Stars David Niven, Frances Rafferty And Tommy Rettig. A young boy fights to win his adoptive mother's love after she becomes pregnant. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Stricken Surgeon. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt And Charles Morgan. When a young surgeon operates on a woman who later dies, Sergeant Cork is called in to solve the case. [S]

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Bride. 1962. Stars Dermot Walsh, Trader Faulkner And Susan Shaw. Urged by his counsellors to marry, Richard sets out in disguise to visit the home of Princess Alice. [S]

programme.title: Tons of Trouble
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy. Directed by Leslie S. Hiscott. Stars Richard Hearne And William Hartnell. Mr Pastry names the apartment boilers he maintains 'Mavis and Ethel'. Trouble begins when he faces the sack. [S]

programme.title: The Belle of Kent 1959
programme.desc: 1959. A travelogue touring the whole of Kent and visits Canterbury Cathedral, an interesting view of this southern county.

programme.title: Sea of Sand
programme.desc: 1958. War. Guy Green. Stars Richard Attenborough, Michael Craig And John Gregson. The Long Range Desert Group go on an expedition through North Africa to destroy a huge Nazi fuel dump. [S]

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Sir David Lean, the British two time Academy Award winning director is best known for his extraordinary cinematic epics like The Bridge on the River Kwai (1957) and Lawrence of Arabia (1962). [S]

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: The Crystal Ball. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Booth Colman And Roxane Berard. A Parisian girl leaves her lover for his wealthy boss, gifting him a crystal ball that shows unsettling visions. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: This week, Mike and Noel have lost and rare reels from behind the scenes of 'Chitty Chitty Bang Bang', as well as a great reel of Melbourne's street cleaners in 1964. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
